# Hooklift Insurance — Contractors Choice Agency

Specialized insurance for hooklift truck operators, roll-off truck operators, crane truck operators, and combo unit operators. Licensed in all 50 states. A-rated carriers. Same-day certificates of insurance.

## About

Contractors Choice Agency (CCA) is a specialty commercial insurance agency founded by Josh Cotner. We focus exclusively on specialty truck operators and contractors, meaning we understand the unique risks of hooklift and roll-off operations better than a general commercial agency.

Phone: 844-967-5247
Email: josh@contractorschoiceagency.com
Address: 12220 E Riggs Road Suite #105, Chandler AZ 85249

## Coverage Types

- General Liability Insurance
- Commercial Auto / Trucking Liability
- Motor Truck Cargo
- Non-Trucking Liability
- Workers Compensation
- Tools & Equipment / Inland Marine
